nodes.label: CI Excludes Benchmarks
nodes.rationale: Shared CI runners produce noisy benchmark measurements, so CI verifies the tool without running benchmarks.

nodes.label: Minimal Dependency Policy
nodes.rationale: Use only BurntSushi/toml and cobra as external dependencies; keep other functionality in the standard library.

nodes.label: Offline Vendored Site Shell
nodes.rationale: Embed pinned marked and highlight.js assets so generated sites work without a CDN or network access.

nodes.label: Profiles Belong to Runs
nodes.rationale: Attach profiles to the run that produced them so later runs cannot inherit evidence from a different binary.

nodes.label: Pinned Go Toolchain
nodes.rationale: Pin Go 1.27.0 so builds are reproducible from the repository alone.

nodes.label: Structured JSON Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Keep structured run and milestone JSON authoritative while Markdown, SVG, and HTML remain derived.
